verses.original: δὲ ὁ ἀρχιερεύς Εἶπεν Εἰ ἔχει ταῦτα οὕτως
verses.transliteration: de ho archiereus Eipen Ei echei tauta houtōs
verses.literal: Then the high priest asked [Stephen] vvv Are these [charges] true

verses.original: δὲ Ὁ ἔφη Ἄνδρες ἀδελφοὶ καὶ πατέρες ἀκούσατε Ὁ Θεὸς τῆς δόξης ὤφθη τῷ ἡμῶν πατρὶ Ἀβραὰμ ὄντι ἐν τῇ Μεσοποταμίᾳ πρὶν ἢ αὐτὸν κατοικῆσαι ἐν Χαρράν
verses.transliteration: de Ho ephē Andres adelphoi kai pateres akousate HO Theos tēs doxēs ōphthē tō hēmōn patri Abraam onti en tē Mesopotamia prin ē auton katoikēsai en Charran
verses.literal: And - [Stephen] declared vvv Brothers and fathers listen [to me] The God - of glory appeared to our father Abraham while he was [still] in - Mesopotamia before . . . he lived in Haran

verses.original: καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτόν Ἔξελθε ἐκ σου τῆς γῆς καὶ ἐκ σου τῆς συγγενείας καὶ δεῦρο εἰς τὴν γῆν ἣν ἄν δείξω σοι
verses.transliteration: kai eipen pros auton Exelthe ek sou tēs gēs kai ek sou tēs syngeneias kai deuro eis tēn gēn hēn an deixō soi
verses.literal: and told . . . him Leave . . . your - country and - your - kindred and go to the land - - I will show you

verses.original: τότε ἐξελθὼν ἐκ γῆς Χαλδαίων κατῴκησεν ἐν Χαρράν μετὰ αὐτοῦ τὸν πατέρα τὸ ἀποθανεῖν μετῴκισεν αὐτὸν κἀκεῖθεν εἰς ταύτην τὴν γῆν εἰς ἣν ὑμεῖς νῦν κατοικεῖτε
verses.transliteration: tote exelthōn ek gēs Chaldaiōn katōkēsen en Charran meta autou ton patera to apothanein metōkisen auton kakeithen eis tautēn tēn gēn eis hēn hymeis nyn katoikeite
verses.literal: [So] [Abraham] left . . . [the] land of the Chaldeans [and] settled in Haran After his - father - died [God] brought him out of that place [and] into this - land vvv where you {are} now living

verses.original: Καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτῷ οὐκ κληρονομίαν ἐν αὐτῇ οὐδὲ βῆμα ποδός καὶ ἐπηγγείλατο δοῦναι εἰς κατάσχεσιν αὐτὴν αὐτῷ καὶ τῷ αὐτοῦ σπέρματι μετ’ αὐτόν ὄντος αὐτῷ οὐκ τέκνου
verses.transliteration: Kai edōken autō ouk klēronomian en autē oude bēma podos kai epēngeilato dounai eis kataschesin autēn autō kai tō autou spermati met’ auton ontos autō ouk teknou
verses.literal: - He gave him no inheritance vvv [here] not even a foot of ground . . . [But] [God] promised to give . . . possession of [the land] to [Abraham] and - his descendants . . . . . . [even though] he did not yet have . . . . . . a child

verses.original: δὲ ὁ Θεὸς ἐλάλησεν οὕτως ὅτι αὐτοῦ τὸ σπέρμα ἔσται πάροικον ἐν ἀλλοτρίᾳ γῇ καὶ δουλώσουσιν αὐτὸ καὶ κακώσουσιν τετρακόσια ἔτη
verses.transliteration: de ho Theos elalēsen houtōs hoti autou to sperma estai paroikon en allotria gē kai doulōsousin auto kai kakōsousin tetrakosia etē
verses.literal: - - God told [him] - that his - descendants would be foreigners in a strange land and [that] they would be enslaved . . . and mistreated four hundred years

verses.original: Καὶ ἐγώ κρινῶ τὸ ἔθνος ᾧ ἐὰν δουλεύσουσιν ὁ Θεὸς εἶπεν Καὶ μετὰ ταῦτα ἐξελεύσονται καὶ λατρεύσουσίν μοι ἐν τούτῳ τῷ τόπῳ
verses.transliteration: Kai egō krinō to ethnos hō ean douleusousin ho Theos eipen Kai meta tauta exeleusontai kai latreusousin moi en toutō tō topō
verses.literal: [But] I will punish the nation [that] vvv enslaves them - God said and afterward . . . they will come forth and worship Me in this - place

verses.original: Καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτῷ διαθήκην περιτομῆς καὶ οὕτως ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἰσαὰκ καὶ περιέτεμεν αὐτὸν τῇ τῇ ὀγδόῃ ἡμέρᾳ καὶ Ἰσαὰκ τὸν Ἰακώβ καὶ Ἰακὼβ τοὺς δώδεκα πατριάρχας
verses.transliteration: Kai edōken autō diathēkēn peritomēs kai houtōs egennēsen ton Isaak kai perietemen auton tē tē ogdoē hēmera kai Isaak ton Iakōb kai Iakōb tous dōdeka patriarchas
verses.literal: Then [God] gave [Abraham] [the] covenant of circumcision and - [Abraham] became the father of - Isaac and circumcised him on the - eighth day And Isaac [became the father of] - Jacob and Jacob of the twelve patriarchs

verses.original: Καὶ οἱ πατριάρχαι ζηλώσαντες τὸν Ἰωσὴφ ἀπέδοντο εἰς Αἴγυπτον καὶ ὁ Θεὸς ἦν μετ’ αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: Kai hoi patriarchai zēlōsantes ton Iōsēph apedonto eis Aigypton kai ho Theos ēn met’ autou
verses.literal: [Because] the patriarchs were jealous - of Joseph they sold him as a slave into Egypt But - God was with him

verses.original: καὶ ἐξείλατο αὐτὸν ἐκ πασῶν αὐτοῦ τῶν θλίψεων καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτῷ χάριν καὶ σοφίαν ἐναντίον Φαραὼ βασιλέως Αἰγύπτου καὶ κατέστησεν αὐτὸν ἡγούμενον ἐπ’ Αἴγυπτον καὶ ἐφ’ ὅλον τὸν αὐτοῦ οἶκον
verses.transliteration: kai exeilato auton ek pasōn autou tōn thlipseōn kai edōken autō charin kai sophian enantion Pharaō basileōs Aigyptou kai katestēsen auton hēgoumenon ep’ Aigypton kai eph’ holon ton autou oikon
verses.literal: and rescued him from all his - troubles - [He] granted [Joseph] favor and wisdom in the sight of Pharaoh king of Egypt [who] appointed him ruler over Egypt and - all - his household

verses.original: δὲ λιμὸς καὶ μεγάλη θλῖψις Ἦλθεν ἐφ’ ὅλην τὴν Αἴγυπτον καὶ Χανάαν καὶ ἡμῶν οἱ πατέρες οὐχ ηὕρισκον χορτάσματα
verses.transliteration: de limos kai megalē thlipsis Ēlthen eph’ holēn tēn Aigypton kai Chanaan kai hēmōn hoi pateres ouch hēuriskon chortasmata
verses.literal: Then famine and great suffering swept vvv across - Egypt and Canaan and our - fathers vvv could not find food

verses.original: δὲ Ἰακὼβ ἀκούσας ὄντα σιτία εἰς Αἴγυπτον ἐξαπέστειλεν ἡμῶν τοὺς πατέρας πρῶτον
verses.transliteration: de Iakōb akousas onta sitia eis Aigypton exapesteilen hēmōn tous pateras prōton
verses.literal: [When] Jacob heard that [there] was grain in Egypt he sent our - fathers [on their] first [visit]

verses.original: καὶ ἐν τῷ δευτέρῳ Ἰωσὴφ ἀνεγνωρίσθη τοῖς αὐτοῦ ἀδελφοῖς καὶ τοῦ Ἰωσήφ τὸ γένος ἐγένετο φανερὸν τῷ Φαραὼ
verses.transliteration: kai en tō deuterō Iōsēph anegnōristhē tois autou adelphois kai tou Iōsēph to genos egeneto phaneron tō Pharaō
verses.literal: - On [their] second [visit] Joseph revealed his identity to his brothers and - [his] - family became known - to Pharaoh

verses.original: δὲ Ἰωσὴφ ἀποστείλας μετεκαλέσατο αὐτοῦ τὸν πατέρα Ἰακὼβ καὶ πᾶσαν τὴν συγγένειαν ἑβδομήκοντα πέντε ψυχαῖς ἐν
verses.transliteration: de Iōsēph aposteilas metekalesato autou ton patera Iakōb kai pasan tēn syngeneian hebdomēkonta pente psychais en
verses.literal: Then Joseph sent for . . . his - father Jacob and all [his] relatives seventy-five . . . . . . in all

verses.original: Καὶ Ἰακὼβ κατέβη εἰς Αἴγυπτον καὶ αὐτὸς καὶ ἡμῶν οἱ πατέρες ἐτελεύτησεν
verses.transliteration: Kai Iakōb katebē eis Aigypton kai autos kai hēmōn hoi pateres eteleutēsen
verses.literal: [So] Jacob went down to Egypt [where] he and our - fathers died

verses.original: καὶ μετετέθησαν εἰς Συχὲμ καὶ ἐτέθησαν ἐν τῷ μνήματι ᾧ Ἀβραὰμ ὠνήσατο παρὰ τῶν υἱῶν Ἑμμὼρ ἐν Συχέμ τιμῆς ἀργυρίου
verses.transliteration: kai metetethēsan eis Sychem kai etethēsan en tō mnēmati hō Abraam ōnēsato para tōn huiōn Hemmōr en Sychem timēs argyriou
verses.literal: [Their bones] were carried back to Shechem and placed in the tomb that Abraham had bought from the sons of Hamor at Shechem for a price he paid in silver

verses.original: δὲ Καθὼς ὁ χρόνος ἤγγιζεν ἧς ὁ Θεὸς τῆς ἐπαγγελίας ὡμολόγησεν τῷ Ἀβραάμ ὁ λαὸς ἐν Αἰγύπτῳ ηὔξησεν καὶ ἐπληθύνθη
verses.transliteration: de Kathōs ho chronos ēngizen hēs ho Theos tēs epangelias hōmologēsen tō Abraam ho laos en Aigyptō ēuxēsen kai eplēthynthē
verses.literal: - As the time drew near for - God - [to fulfill] His promise . . . - to Abraham [our] people in Egypt increased - greatly in number

verses.original: ἄχρι οὗ ἕτερος βασιλεὺς ὃς ᾔδει οὐκ τὸν Ἰωσήφ ἀνέστη ἐπ’ Αἴγυπτον
verses.transliteration: achri hou heteros basileus hos ēdei ouk ton Iōsēph anestē ep’ Aigypton
verses.literal: Then . . . another king who knew nothing - of Joseph arose over Egypt

verses.original: οὗτος κατασοφισάμενος ἡμῶν τὸ γένος ἐκάκωσεν ἡμῶν τοὺς πατέρας τοῦ ποιεῖν ἔκθετα αὐτῶν τὰ βρέφη εἰς τὸ μὴ ζωογονεῖσθαι
verses.transliteration: houtos katasophisamenos hēmōn to genos ekakōsen hēmōn tous pateras tou poiein ektheta autōn ta brephē eis to mē zōogoneisthai
verses.literal: He exploited our - people [and] oppressed our - fathers - forcing [them] to abandon their - infants so . . . vvv they would die

verses.original: Ἐν ᾧ καιρῷ Μωϋσῆς ἐγεννήθη καὶ ἦν ἀστεῖος τῷ Θεῷ τρεῖς μῆνας ὃς ἀνετράφη ἐν τῷ τοῦ πατρός οἴκῳ
verses.transliteration: En hō kairō Mōusēs egennēthē kai ēn asteios tō Theō treis mēnas hos anetraphē en tō tou patros oikō
verses.literal: At that time Moses was born and he was beautiful - in the sight of God [For] three months [he] was nurtured in [his] - father’s house

verses.original: δὲ αὐτοῦ ἐκτεθέντος Φαραὼ ἡ θυγάτηρ ἀνείλατο αὐτὸν καὶ ἀνεθρέψατο αὐτὸν εἰς ἑαυτῇ υἱόν
verses.transliteration: de autou ektethentos Pharaō hē thygatēr aneilato auton kai anethrepsato auton eis heautē huion
verses.literal: [When] he was set outside Pharaoh’s - daughter took him . . . and brought him up . . . as her own son

verses.original: καὶ Μωϋσῆς ἐπαιδεύθη ἐν πάσῃ σοφίᾳ Αἰγυπτίων δὲ ἦν δυνατὸς ἐν αὐτοῦ λόγοις καὶ ἔργοις
verses.transliteration: kai Mōusēs epaideuthē en pasē sophia Aigyptiōn de ēn dynatos en autou logois kai ergois
verses.literal: So Moses was educated in all [the] wisdom of [the] Egyptians and was powerful in - speech and action

verses.original: δὲ Ὡς αὐτῷ χρόνος τεσσερακονταέτης ἐπληροῦτο ἀνέβη ἐπὶ αὐτοῦ τὴν καρδίαν ἐπισκέψασθαι αὐτοῦ τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς τοὺς υἱοὺς Ἰσραήλ
verses.transliteration: de Hōs autō chronos tesserakontaetēs eplērouto anebē epi autou tēn kardian episkepsasthai autou tous adelphous tous huious Israēl
verses.literal: - When [Moses] [was] forty years [old] he decided . . . . . . . . . . . . to visit his - brothers the children of Israel

verses.original: καὶ ἰδών τινα ἀδικούμενον ἠμύνατο καὶ ἐποίησεν ἐκδίκησιν πατάξας τὸν Αἰγύπτιον τῷ καταπονουμένῳ
verses.transliteration: kai idōn tina adikoumenon ēmynato kai epoiēsen ekdikēsin pataxas ton Aigyption tō kataponoumenō
verses.literal: And when he saw one [of them] being mistreated [Moses] went to his defense and vvv avenged [him] by striking down the Egyptian - who was oppressing [him]

verses.original: δὲ ἐνόμιζεν τοὺς αὐτοῦ ἀδελφοὺς συνιέναι ὅτι ὁ Θεὸς διὰ αὐτοῦ χειρὸς δίδωσιν αὐτοῖς σωτηρίαν δὲ οἱ οὐ συνῆκαν
verses.transliteration: de enomizen tous autou adelphous synienai hoti ho Theos dia autou cheiros didōsin autois sōtērian de hoi ou synēkan
verses.literal: - He assumed - his brothers would understand that - God vvv vvv was using him vvv vvv to deliver them but - vvv [they did not]

verses.original: τε Τῇ ἐπιούσῃ ἡμέρᾳ ὤφθη αὐτοῖς μαχομένοις καὶ συνήλλασσεν αὐτοὺς εἰς εἰρήνην εἰπών Ἄνδρες ἐστε ἀδελφοί ἱνα‿ τί ἀδικεῖτε ἀλλήλους
verses.transliteration: te Tē epiousē hēmera ōphthē autois machomenois kai synēllassen autous eis eirēnēn eipōn Andres este adelphoi hina ti adikeite allēlous
verses.literal: - The next day he came upon [two Israelites who] were fighting - and he tried to reconcile them . . . . . . . . . saying Men you are brothers vvv Why are you mistreating each other

verses.original: δὲ Ὁ ἀδικῶν τὸν πλησίον ἀπώσατο αὐτὸν εἰπών Τίς κατέστησεν σε ἄρχοντα καὶ δικαστὴν ἐφ’ ἡμῶν
verses.transliteration: de Ho adikōn ton plēsion apōsato auton eipōn Tis katestēsen se archonta kai dikastēn eph’ hēmōn
verses.literal: But the [man who] was abusing [his] neighbor pushed [Moses] aside . . . [and] said Who made you ruler and judge over us

verses.original: σὺ μὴ θέλεις ἀνελεῖν με ὃν τρόπον ἀνεῖλες τὸν Αἰγύπτιον ἐχθὲς
verses.transliteration: sy mē theleis anelein me hon tropon aneiles ton Aigyption echthes
verses.literal: {Do} you vvv want to kill me . . . as . . . you killed the Egyptian yesterday

verses.original: δὲ ἐν τούτῳ τῷ λόγῳ Μωϋσῆς ἔφυγεν ἐν γῇ Μαδιάμ οὗ καὶ ἐγένετο πάροικος ἐγέννησεν δύο υἱοὺς
verses.transliteration: de en toutō tō logō Mōusēs ephygen en gē Madiam hou kai egeneto paroikos egennēsen dyo huious
verses.literal: - At this - remark Moses fled to [the] land of Midian where - he lived as a foreigner [and] had two sons

verses.original: Καὶ τεσσεράκοντα ἐτῶν πληρωθέντων ἄγγελος ὤφθη αὐτῷ ἐν φλογὶ πυρὸς βάτου ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ τοῦ ὄρους Σινᾶ
verses.transliteration: Kai tesserakonta etōn plērōthentōn angelos ōphthē autō en phlogi pyros batou en tē erēmō tou orous Sina
verses.literal: [After] forty years had passed an angel appeared to [Moses] in [the] flames of a burning bush in the desert near Mount Sinai

verses.original: δὲ ὁ Μωϋσῆς ἰδὼν ἐθαύμαζεν τὸ ὅραμα δὲ αὐτοῦ προσερχομένου κατανοῆσαι φωνὴ Κυρίου ἐγένετο
verses.transliteration: de ho Mōusēs idōn ethaumazen to horama de autou proserchomenou katanoēsai phōnē Kyriou egeneto
verses.literal: [When] - Moses saw [it] he marveled at the sight - [As] he approached to look [more closely] [the] voice of [the] Lord came [to him]

verses.original: Ἐγὼ ὁ Θεὸς σου τῶν πατέρων ὁ Θεὸς Ἀβραὰμ καὶ Ἰσαὰκ καὶ Ἰακώβ δὲ Μωϋσῆς γενόμενος ἔντρομος οὐκ ἐτόλμα κατανοῆσαι
verses.transliteration: Egō ho Theos sou tōn paterōn ho Theos Abraam kai Isaak kai Iakōb de Mōusēs genomenos entromos ouk etolma katanoēsai
verses.literal: I [am] the God of your - fathers the God of Abraham - Isaac and Jacob - Moses vvv trembled with fear vvv [and] did not dare to look

verses.original: δὲ ὁ Κύριος Εἶπεν αὐτῷ Λῦσον τῶν σου ποδῶν τὸ ὑπόδημα γὰρ ὁ τόπος ἐφ’ ᾧ ἕστηκας ἐστίν ἁγία γῆ
verses.transliteration: de ho Kyrios Eipen autō Lyson tōn sou podōn to hypodēma gar ho topos eph’ hō hestēkas estin hagia gē
verses.literal: Then the Lord said to him Take off . . . . . . . . . [your] sandals for the place vvv where you are standing is holy ground

verses.original: ἰδὼν εἶδον τὴν κάκωσιν τοῦ μου λαοῦ τοῦ ἐν Αἰγύπτῳ καὶ ἤκουσα αὐτοῦ τοῦ στεναγμοῦ καὶ κατέβην ἐξελέσθαι αὐτούς καὶ νῦν δεῦρο ἀποστείλω σε εἰς Αἴγυπτον
verses.transliteration: idōn eidon tēn kakōsin tou mou laou tou en Aigyptō kai ēkousa autou tou stenagmou kai katebēn exelesthai autous kai nyn deuro aposteilō se eis Aigypton
verses.literal: I have indeed seen . . . the oppression of My people - in Egypt - I have heard their - groaning and have come down to deliver them - Now come I will send you back to Egypt

verses.original: Τοῦτον τὸν Μωϋσῆν ὃν ἠρνήσαντο εἰπόντες Τίς κατέστησεν σε ἄρχοντα καὶ δικαστήν τοῦτον ὁ Θεὸς ἀπέσταλκεν καὶ ἄρχοντα καὶ λυτρωτὴν σὺν χειρὶ ἀγγέλου τοῦ ὀφθέντος αὐτῷ ἐν τῇ βάτῳ
verses.transliteration: Touton ton Mōusēn hon ērnēsanto eipontes Tis katestēsen se archonta kai dikastēn touton ho Theos apestalken kai archonta kai lytrōtēn syn cheiri angelou tou ophthentos autō en tē batō
verses.literal: This - Moses whom they had rejected with the words Who made you ruler and judge [is] the one whom God sent - to be [their] ruler and redeemer through . . . [the] angel who appeared to him in the bush

verses.original: οὗτος ἐξήγαγεν αὐτοὺς ποιήσας τέρατα καὶ σημεῖα ἐν γῇ Αἰγύπτῳ καὶ ἐν Ἐρυθρᾷ Θαλάσσῃ καὶ τεσσεράκοντα ἔτη ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ
verses.transliteration: houtos exēgagen autous poiēsas terata kai sēmeia en gē Aigyptō kai en Erythra Thalassē kai tesserakonta etē en tē erēmō
verses.literal: [He] led them out . . . [and] performed wonders and signs in [the] land of Egypt - at [the] Red Sea and [for] forty years in the wilderness

verses.original: Οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ Μωϋσῆς ὁ εἴπας τοῖς υἱοῖς Ἰσραήλ ὁ Θεὸς ἀναστήσει ὑμῖν Προφήτην ὡς ἐμέ ἐκ ὑμῶν τῶν ἀδελφῶν
verses.transliteration: Houtos estin ho Mōusēs ho eipas tois huiois Israēl ho Theos anastēsei hymin Prophētēn hōs eme ek hymōn tōn adelphōn
verses.literal: This is the [same] Moses who told the vvv Israelites - God will raise up for you a prophet like me from among your - brothers

verses.original: οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ γενόμενος ἐν τῇ ἐκκλησίᾳ ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ μετὰ τοῦ ἀγγέλου τοῦ λαλοῦντος αὐτῷ ἐν τῷ ὄρει Σινᾶ καὶ ὃς τῶν ἡμῶν πατέρων ἐδέξατο ζῶντα λόγια δοῦναι ἡμῖν
verses.transliteration: houtos estin ho genomenos en tē ekklēsia en tē erēmō meta tou angelou tou lalountos autō en tō orei Sina kai hos tōn hēmōn paterōn edexato zōnta logia dounai hēmin
verses.literal: [He] - - was in the assembly in the wilderness with the angel who spoke to him on - Mount Sinai and [with] - our fathers [And] he received living words to pass on to us

verses.original: ἡμῶν οἱ πατέρες ἠθέλησαν οὐκ γενέσθαι ὑπήκοοι ᾧ ἀλλὰ ἀπώσαντο καὶ ἐν αὐτῶν ταῖς καρδίαις ἐστράφησαν εἰς Αἴγυπτον
verses.transliteration: hēmōn hoi pateres ēthelēsan ouk genesthai hypēkooi hō alla apōsanto kai en autōn tais kardiais estraphēsan eis Aigypton
verses.literal: [But] our - fathers refused . . . to obey [him] Instead they rejected [him] and in their - hearts turned back to Egypt

verses.original: εἰπόντες τῷ Ἀαρών Ποίησον ἡμῖν θεοὺς οἳ προπορεύσονται ἡμῶν γὰρ οὗτος ὁ Μωϋσῆς ὃς ἐξήγαγεν ἡμᾶς ἐκ γῆς Αἰγύπτου οὐκ οἴδαμεν τί ἐγένετο αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: eipontes tō Aarōn Poiēson hēmin theous hoi proporeusontai hēmōn gar houtos ho Mōusēs hos exēgagen hēmas ek gēs Aigyptou ouk oidamen ti egeneto autō
verses.literal: They said - to Aaron Make us gods who will go before us As for this - Moses who led us . . . out of [the] land of Egypt vvv we do not know what has happened to him

verses.original: ἐν ἐκείναις ταῖς ἡμέραις Καὶ ἐμοσχοποίησαν καὶ ἀνήγαγον θυσίαν τῷ εἰδώλῳ καὶ εὐφραίνοντο ἐν τοῖς ἔργοις τῶν αὐτῶν χειρῶν
verses.transliteration: en ekeinais tais hēmerais Kai emoschopoiēsan kai anēgagon thysian tō eidōlō kai euphrainonto en tois ergois tōn autōn cheirōn
verses.literal: At that - time - they made a calf and offered a sacrifice to the idol - rejoicing in the works of their hands

verses.original: δὲ ὁ Θεὸς ἔστρεψεν καὶ παρέδωκεν αὐτοὺς λατρεύειν τῇ στρατιᾷ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καθὼς γέγραπται ἐν βίβλῳ τῶν προφητῶν Μὴ προσηνέγκατέ μοι σφάγια καὶ θυσίας τεσσεράκοντα ἔτη ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ οἶκος Ἰσραήλ
verses.transliteration: de ho Theos estrepsen kai paredōken autous latreuein tē stratia tou ouranou kathōs gegraptai en biblō tōn prophētōn Mē prosēnenkate moi sphagia kai thysias tesserakonta etē en tē erēmō oikos Israēl
verses.literal: But - God turned away [from them] and gave them over . . . to the worship of the host of heaven as it is written in [the] book of the prophets vvv Did you bring Me sacrifices and offerings forty years in the wilderness O house of Israel

verses.original: καὶ ἀνελάβετε τὴν σκηνὴν τοῦ Μολὸχ καὶ τὸ ἄστρον τοῦ ὑμῶν θεοῦ Ῥαιφάν τοὺς τύπους οὓς ἐποιήσατε προσκυνεῖν αὐτοῖς καὶ μετοικιῶ ὑμᾶς ἐπέκεινα Βαβυλῶνος
verses.transliteration: kai anelabete tēn skēnēn tou Moloch kai to astron tou hymōn theou Rhaiphan tous typous hous epoiēsate proskynein autois kai metoikiō hymas epekeina Babylōnos
verses.literal: - You have taken along the tabernacle - of Molech and the star of your god Rephan the idols - you made to worship - [Therefore] I will send you into exile . . . beyond Babylon

verses.original: ἡμῶν πατράσιν ἦν Ἡ σκηνὴ τοῦ μαρτυρίου τοῖς ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ ποιῆσαι αὐτὴν καθὼς ὁ λαλῶν διετάξατο τῷ Μωϋσῇ κατὰ τὸν τύπον ὃν ἑωράκει
verses.transliteration: hēmōn patrasin ēn Hē skēnē tou martyriou tois en tē erēmō poiēsai autēn kathōs ho lalōn dietaxato tō Mōusē kata ton typon hon heōrakei
verses.literal: Our fathers [had] the tabernacle of the Testimony with [them] in the wilderness [It was] constructed . . . exactly as [God] . . . had directed - Moses according to the pattern - he had seen

verses.original: καὶ ἡμῶν οἱ πατέρες ἣν διαδεξάμενοι εἰσήγαγον μετὰ Ἰησοῦ ἐν τῇ κατασχέσει τῶν ἐθνῶν ὧν ὁ Θεὸς ἐξῶσεν ἀπὸ προσώπου τῶν ἡμῶν πατέρων ἕως τῶν ἡμερῶν Δαυίδ
verses.transliteration: kai hēmōn hoi pateres hēn diadexamenoi eisēgagon meta Iēsou en tē kataschesei tōn ethnōn hōn ho Theos exōsen apo prosōpou tōn hēmōn paterōn heōs tōn hēmerōn Dauid
verses.literal: And our - fathers who received it brought [it in] with Joshua [when] - they dispossessed the nations - - God drove out before . . . . . . vvv [them] [It remained] until the time of David

verses.original: ὃς εὗρεν χάριν ἐνώπιον τοῦ Θεοῦ καὶ ᾐτήσατο εὑρεῖν σκήνωμα τῷ Θεῷ Ἰακώβ
verses.transliteration: hos heuren charin enōpion tou Theou kai ētēsato heurein skēnōma tō Theō Iakōb
verses.literal: who found favor in the sight - of God and asked to provide a dwelling place for the God of Jacob

verses.original: δὲ Σολομῶν οἰκοδόμησεν οἶκον αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: de Solomōn oikodomēsen oikon autō
verses.literal: But [it was] Solomon [who] built [the] house for Him

verses.original: Ἀλλ’ ὁ Ὕψιστος οὐχ κατοικεῖ ἐν χειροποιήτοις καθὼς ὁ προφήτης λέγει
verses.transliteration: All’ ho Hypsistos ouch katoikei en cheiropoiētois kathōs ho prophētēs legei
verses.literal: However the Most High {does} not dwell in [houses] made by human hands As the prophet says

verses.original: Ὁ οὐρανός μοι θρόνος δὲ ἡ γῆ τῶν μου ποδῶν ὑποπόδιον ποῖον οἶκον οἰκοδομήσετέ μοι λέγει Κύριος ἢ τίς τῆς μου τόπος καταπαύσεώς
verses.transliteration: Ho ouranos moi thronos de hē gē tōn mou podōn hypopodion poion oikon oikodomēsete moi legei Kyrios ē tis tēs mou topos katapauseōs
verses.literal: - Heaven [is] My throne and the earth vvv vvv [is] My footstool What kind of house will you build for Me says [the] Lord or where [will] - My place of repose [be]

verses.original: οὐχὶ μου ἡ χείρ ἐποίησεν πάντα ταῦτα
verses.transliteration: ouchi mou hē cheir epoiēsen panta tauta
verses.literal: {Has} not My - hand made all these things

verses.original: Σκληροτράχηλοι καὶ ἀπερίτμητοι καρδίαις καὶ τοῖς ὠσίν ὑμεῖς ἀεὶ ἀντιπίπτετε τῷ τῷ Ἁγίῳ Πνεύματι ὑμεῖς καὶ ὡς ὑμῶν οἱ πατέρες
verses.transliteration: Sklērotrachēloi kai aperitmētoi kardiais kai tois ōsin hymeis aei antipiptete tō tō Hagiō Pneumati hymeis kai hōs hymōn hoi pateres
verses.literal: [You] stiff-necked [people] [with] uncircumcised hearts and - ears You always resist the - Holy Spirit - just as your - fathers [did]

verses.original: τίνα τῶν προφητῶν ὑμῶν οἱ πατέρες οὐκ ἐδίωξαν καὶ ἀπέκτειναν τοὺς προκαταγγείλαντας περὶ τῆς ἐλεύσεως τοῦ Δικαίου νῦν ὑμεῖς ἐγένεσθε οὗ προδόται καὶ φονεῖς
verses.transliteration: tina tōn prophētōn hymōn hoi pateres ouk ediōxan kai apekteinan tous prokatangeilantas peri tēs eleuseōs tou Dikaiou nyn hymeis egenesthe hou prodotai kai phoneis
verses.literal: Which of the prophets {did} your - fathers fail to persecute vvv They even killed those who foretold . . . the coming of the Righteous One And now you are [His] betrayers and murderers

verses.original: οἵτινες ἐλάβετε τὸν νόμον διαταγὰς εἰς ἀγγέλων καὶ οὐκ ἐφυλάξατε
verses.transliteration: hoitines elabete ton nomon diatagas eis angelōn kai ouk ephylaxate
verses.literal: [you] who received the law ordained by angels yet vvv have not kept [it]

verses.original: δὲ Ἀκούοντες ταῦτα διεπρίοντο ταῖς αὐτῶν καρδίαις καὶ ἔβρυχον τοὺς ὀδόντας ἐπ’ αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: de Akouontes tauta dieprionto tais autōn kardiais kai ebrychon tous odontas ep’ auton
verses.literal: - On hearing this [the members of the Sanhedrin] were enraged . . . . . . . . . and they gnashed [their] teeth at him

verses.original: δὲ ὑπάρχων πλήρης Ἁγίου Πνεύματος ἀτενίσας εἰς τὸν οὐρανὸν εἶδεν δόξαν Θεοῦ καὶ Ἰησοῦν ἑστῶτα ἐκ δεξιῶν τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: de hyparchōn plērēs Hagiou Pneumatos atenisas eis ton ouranon eiden doxan Theou kai Iēsoun hestōta ek dexiōn tou Theou
verses.literal: But [Stephen] full vvv of [the] Holy Spirit looked intently into - heaven [and] saw [the] glory of God and Jesus standing at the right hand - of God

verses.original: Ἰδοὺ καὶ εἶπεν θεωρῶ τοὺς οὐρανοὺς διηνοιγμένους καὶ τὸν Υἱὸν τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἑστῶτα ἐκ δεξιῶν τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: Idou kai eipen theōrō tous ouranous diēnoigmenous kai ton Huion tou anthrōpou hestōta ek dexiōn tou Theou
verses.literal: Look - he said I see - heaven open and the Son - of Man standing at the right [hand] - of God

verses.original: δὲ συνέσχον αὐτῶν τὰ ὦτα Κράξαντες μεγάλῃ φωνῇ καὶ ὥρμησαν ὁμοθυμαδὸν ἐπ’ αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: de syneschon autōn ta ōta Kraxantes megalē phōnē kai hōrmēsan homothymadon ep’ auton
verses.literal: At this they covered their - ears cried out vvv in a loud voice and rushed together at him

verses.original: καὶ ἐκβαλόντες ἔξω τῆς πόλεως ἐλιθοβόλουν καὶ οἱ μάρτυρες ἀπέθεντο αὐτῶν τὰ ἱμάτια παρὰ τοὺς πόδας νεανίου καλουμένου Σαύλου
verses.transliteration: kai ekbalontes exō tēs poleōs elithoboloun kai hoi martyres apethento autōn ta himatia para tous podas neaniou kaloumenou Saulou
verses.literal: - They dragged [him] out of the city [and] began to stone [him] Meanwhile the witnesses laid their - garments at the feet of a young man named Saul

verses.original: Καὶ ἐλιθοβόλουν τὸν Στέφανον ἐπικαλούμενον καὶ λέγοντα Κύριε Ἰησοῦ δέξαι μου τὸ πνεῦμά
verses.transliteration: Kai elithoboloun ton Stephanon epikaloumenon kai legonta Kyrie Iēsou dexai mou to pneuma
verses.literal: [While] they were stoning [him] - Stephen appealed . . . . . . Lord Jesus receive my - spirit

verses.original: δὲ θεὶς τὰ γόνατα ἔκραξεν μεγάλῃ φωνῇ Κύριε μὴ στήσῃς ταύτην τὴν ἁμαρτίαν αὐτοῖς καὶ εἰπὼν τοῦτο ἐκοιμήθη
verses.transliteration: de theis ta gonata ekraxen megalē phōnē Kyrie mē stēsēs tautēn tēn hamartian autois kai eipōn touto ekoimēthē
verses.literal: - Falling on [his] knees he cried out in a loud voice Lord {do} not hold this - sin against them And when he had said this he fell asleep
